_comment: All interface text for the TV and the phone website. To add a language, copy this file to <name>.json (e.g. ua.json), set language.name (shown in the language list) and language.tag (the BCP 47 code, e.g. uk) and translate the values; missing keys fall back to English. {name} marks a value filled in by the app. A key ending in _one is used when {count} is 1; for languages with more plural forms, word the plain key so the number needs no agreement ("Photos: {count}").
language.name: English
tv.type_hint: Hold OK to move, hide or change
tv.button_empty: Nothing on the {color} button yet. Hold OK on a tile to assign one.
update.title: Glass Home {version} is ready
update.lead: Install it now? Glass Home closes for a few seconds and opens again. Your settings and photos stay.
buttons.title: Open {app} with
icons.title: Icon for {app}
icons.hint: Add your own icons on the website: hold OK, then Set up from your phone.
wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.pick_one: Or choose one photo to keep on screen:
phone.title: Set up from your phone
phone.scan: Point your phone's camera at the code.
phone.scan_detail: It opens the website and signs you in.
phone.or_open: Or open on a phone on this Wi-Fi:
phone.no_wifi: Connect the TV to Wi-Fi first.
web.tv.photos_from_phone: To add photos, open this website on a phone: hold OK on an app on the TV and choose Set up from your phone.
web.tv.icons_from_phone: To add icons, open this website on a phone: hold OK on an app on the TV and choose Set up from your phone.
phone.qr_description: QR code that opens the Glass Home website on your phone
server.home_only: Only devices on the home network can use this page.
server.error: Something went wrong on the TV. Try again.
web.signin_lead: The code is on the TV:
web.signin_step1: Press Home on the TV’s remote.
web.signin_step2: Hold OK on any tile and choose Set up from your phone.
web.signin_step3: Scan the QR code with this phone’s camera: that signs you in. Or type the 6 digits here.
web.look.night_lead: Warmer and dimmer in the evening, so the screen doesn't light up the room.
web.buttons.title: Colour buttons
web.wrong_code: That code doesn’t match the one on the TV.
web.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {minutes} min.
web.offline: Can’t reach the TV. Check that this phone is on the home Wi-Fi.
web.home.title: Home button
web.home.label: Home opens
web.home.lead: At once: Google TV doesn't start and its screen doesn't flash; holding Home no longer opens the Google TV panel. After Google TV: Google TV opens first and Glass Home comes in front of it. Only on TVs set up with scripts/install/set-home.sh.
web.footer: Glass Home answers only on your home network. This phone stays signed in for 30 days.
web.photos.title: Photos
web.photos.lead: Your photos play on the TV before the built-in nature ones. Portrait photos are shown whole; landscape ones are framed around faces.
web.photos.motion: Slow zoom on photos (off: still photos, a quieter TV)
web.photos.grid_label: Your photos. Drag the handle to reorder.
web.photos.empty: No photos yet. The TV shows its nature photos until you add some.
web.photos.full: The TV has 300 photos already. Delete some to add more.
web.photos.move: Move photo {number}. Drag, or use the arrow keys.
web.weather_style.week_note: Seven days on a frosted panel, like the original Glass Home. Clock, Glass and Type themes.
web.weather_style.line_note: In words, next to the date.
web.weather_style.compact_note: Icon and temperature by the date.
web.weather_style.corner_note: Large, top right. Clock and Type themes.
web.weather_style.forecast_note: Corner plus the next 3 days. Clock and Type themes.
web.look.buttons_tip: Tip: put an app on a red, green, yellow or blue remote button. On the TV, hold OK on a tile.
web.theme.postcard_note: Photo as a card, app menu.
web.dock.title: Dock
web.dock.lead: The apps and devices on the TV, in order. Hidden ones stay installed.
web.weather.title: Weather
web.weather.pick: Pick your city to show the weather on the TV.
web.weather.showing: Showing the weather for {place}. Find another city to change it.
web.weather.off: Weather is off on the TV.
web.weather.none: No city found with that name. Try the spelling used on maps.
web.open.title: Open on the TV
web.open.lead: Paste a link: the TV opens it in the app for it. YouTube links open in YouTube, other pages in a browser, if one is installed on the TV.
web.open.label: Link to open on the TV
web.open.bad_link: That doesn’t look like a web link. It should start with http:// or https://
web.open.no_app: No app on the TV opens web links. Install a browser from Google Play on the TV, TV Bro for example.
web.open.no_answer: The TV didn’t answer. Check that this phone is on the home Wi-Fi, then press Open again.
web.album.title: Shared album
web.album.lead: Paste a public iCloud shared album link (with Public Website on) or a Google Photos share link. The TV checks for new photos every 6 hours.
web.album.label: Shared album link
web.album.failed: The TV couldn’t open this album. Check that the link is public.
web.album.count: {count} photos from the album are on the TV.
web.album.bad_link: That doesn’t look like a share link. It should start with https://
web.icons.title: Icons
web.icons.lead: Pictures for dock tiles, cropped to a square. On the TV: hold OK on a tile, then Change icon.
web.language.title: Language
web.language.lead: For the TV and this website.
web.update.title: Updates
web.update.ready: Version {version} is downloaded. It installs only when you say so.
web.update.development: Built from source: updates from GitHub are off.
web.update.checks: Check GitHub for new versions once a day
web.update.skipped: Skipped. The TV asks again when a newer version comes out.
web.update.installing: Installing. Glass Home opens again in a few seconds.
web.update.confirm: Confirm the update on the TV.
web.update.other_key: Version {version} is out, but this Glass Home was built with another key, so Android can’t install it over this one. Install glass-home.apk from the Releases page instead (settings and photos are lost).
